races.name: Willpower Group Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: DASHING DICK has been cut plenty of slack by the handicapper and will appreciate the drop back in trip after a solid effort at Yarmouth last time. He makes most appeal. Shark Two One and Sir David ran well here last month and may provide the chief threat.

runners.note: C&D winner. Yet to score this year but has dropped to a handy mark and arrives on the back of respectable fifth of 14 in handicap at Yarmouth (1m, good) 19 days ago. Shortlist material.
C&D winner but not scored since 2024 and needs to bounce back from below-par run at Carlisle (7f, good to soft) 27 days ago.
Has drawn a blank since making a winning start for current yard at Newmarket (7f) last summer. Tumbled down the weights, though, and can't be discounted dropped back in grade here.
On a lengthy losing run but has made the frame on several occasions off higher marks this year. Can make presence felt but others preferred for win purposes.
Remains a maiden after 14 starts and added another placed effort to her portfolio latest, finishing third of 10 in handicap at Thirsk (7f, good) 22 days ago. May need some help from the assessor.

Posted a career best when belatedly off the mark at Epsom (7f) in July and back to that sort of form when creditable third of 13 in handicap at Kempton (7f) 13 days ago, running on. One of the likelier contenders.
Responded well to headgear when second at Ffos Las in August but not built on that and losing run continues to grow.

Tumbled down the weights and back on the scoreboard at Beverley in August. Ran to similar level when good neck second of 14 to Shark Two One in handicap over C&D (good to firm) 15 days ago. Enters calculations.
Successful in an all-weather nursery last winter and proved as good as ever when second at Pontefract (1m) in July. Rather gone backwards since, however, and no surprise to see headgear reached for.

Goes well at this venue and was returning from 12 weeks off when taking 14-runner handicap (11/1) over C&D (good to firm) 15 days ago by neck from Sir David. Just 3 lb higher now and ought to go well again.

races.name: Matchbook Signup - Get 20% Back On Losses Apprentice Handicap (Hands And Heels)
races.verdict: JENSON BENSON has returned from an absence on good order, snapping a lengthy losing sequence here last month. He can follow up at the chief expense of Haveagobeau and Launceston.

runners.note: Added to a couple of all-weather victories when scoring on turf at Lingfield (1¼m) in July. Shaped as though still in form both starts since and is expected to remain very competitive at this level.

Exceeded market expectations back from 10 months off (fitted with cheekpieces) when second at Hamilton in August and snapped a losing sequence dating back to 2022 over C&D last month. Nudged up just 2 lb and remains well

Stepped up with each run for this yard, off the mark in classified company at Ffos Las in August (1m) and followed that with a good third at Bath upped to this trip back in handicap company. Can get involved again.
Runner-up on 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap debut in May. Into her shell after for Ed Dunlop and now goes up in distance for new yard from falling mark.

Was prominent in the betting for handicap debut and showed more than previously when 4½ lengths third of 6 at Wolverhampton in April (1½m). Brushed aside over the same C&D 2 weeks later and has since left John & Thady Go
Won at Chepstow from 4 lb higher mark over 1m in June but has struggled in 6 runs since. Down in class with blinkers now on but has lots to prove.

Had looked fairly limited for a while but cranked it up a notch when springing a surprise in 10-runner handicap at Epsom in August. Found the going tougher back against the 3-y-os at Lingfield 4 weeks ago but now returns
Ended a long losing run in Lingfield classified event in January. Has made the frame several times since and no surprise cheekpieces are discarded following a poor effort over 1m here in August.

Recorded a hat-trick last season (including 2 C&D wins). Has struggled for form this year but did at least finish off his race with more purpose when 1¾ lengths fourth of 10 to Jenson Benson over C&D a month ago.
Minor promise only for Daniel McLoughlin in Ireland and she returns from 8 months off.

races.name: Tote Always SP Or Better At Galway Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: YOUNG REBEL will benefit from a stiffer test but he made an encouraging start for his new connections in a stronger event here 2 months ago and this could be a good opening for him. Baila Conmigo got back on track at Downpatrick and can go well for his in-form yard. Mister Class looks the pick of the newcomers.

runners.note: Bumper winner for Martin Fitzgerald. In the process of running well (may have won) until falling late on in maiden hurdle at Roscommon in July but finished well beaten at Navan a fortnight ago. Keith Donoghue now rides s
Fair maiden at best on Flat (all-weather). Has failed to complete in 2 maiden hurdles (for new yard latest). Hood/cheekpieces go on.
250/1, little promise in novice hurdle here on debut last month.
125/1, well beaten in Killarney bumper on debut in August.

Ocovango gelding. Dam unraced out of sister to useful staying chaser Mondial Jack and half-sister to very smart French staying chaser Grey Jack, from family of useful hurdler/chaser up to 2½m Granit Jack. Hood fitted for
Idaho gelding. Dam unraced daughter of temperamental winning 2m hurdler Vocative. Wears hood.
Caught the eye when seventh of 17 in maiden hurdle at Listowel in May, finishing with running left. Hasn't achieved much in 2 starts since (Roscommon novice hurdle/Listowel bumper), however.
Capri gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including fairly useful 2½m hurdle winner Global Fame and fairly useful hurdler President Scottie. Some appeal on paper.

Justified support on debut when producing a strong late surge to land a Fairyhouse bumper in November from a subsequent Grade 2 winner. Picked up by top owner out of the Margaret Mullins yard after and shaped well in 17f

Fair 3-time winner over middle distances at Dundalk and back on the up in this sphere when fourth in eventful maiden at Downpatrick (2¼m) 3 weeks ago, no extra in the final 1f (lost 2 places close home) after making most
Blue Bresil gelding who did no more than hint at ability when mid-division in a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan on debut in April and is probably one for handicaps later on.
Tailed off in a Punchestown bumper in February but showed a bit more in 2m Listowel maiden hurdle a fortnight ago. Likely to need more time.
Seemed more straightforward in first-time cheekpieces when second to promising winner in 2m Roscommon maiden hurdle last week but his wait for a first victory seems set to continue.
100/1, never dangerous in Listowel maiden hurdle on debut a fortnight ago.
Telecaster gelding. Half-brother to French hurdler/chaser Le Philosophe. Dam 1½m/13f winner in France. One of 3 runners for Gavin Cromwell and Keith Donoghue rides. The market could guide.
€40,000 buy. Maiden pointer, third last time (May 2026). Might need more time.
Little impact in various company.
Yard has had success with this family and she showed a bit on her belated debut at Listowel a fortnight ago, never on terms but not unduly punished. Entitled to improve.
Well held in a Naas juvenile hurdle and Limerick listed bumper.
Elzaam filly. Half-sister to 2 winners on Flat, including Italian 5f winner Ionica. Dam 1½m winner.

Half-brother to 4 winners, including fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser Dandy Dan (winner up to 3¼m, by Midnight Legend) and useful bumper winner/fair 2m hurdle winner Bigbadandbeautiful (by Big Bad Bob). Off mark in po
Winning pointer, unplaced last time (May 2026). Wears a hood. RESERVE.

races.name: Agri Day At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: CINNODIN took a clear step back in the right direction in a change of headgear when fourth at Uttoxeter 3 weeks ago and may still have a bit of untapped potential as a stayer, so he receives the tentative vote. The Wise Traveller isn't getting any younger, but is only 2 lb higher than for his C&D success in May and is capable fresh.

runners.note: Fairly-useful Flat performer who opened his account in this sphere at Uttoxeter (23f) in May and backed that up when a good second there 3 weeks later. Poor efforts next 2 outings but took a clear step back in the right

Enhanced fine record under Sean Bowen when opening his account for the year at Worcester (23f) in July. Ran at least as well when 1½ lengths third over same C&D next time, but not at his best there latest.

Maiden hurdler who made a successful start over fences in handicap chase at Sedgefield (21f) in April, despite tendency to jump right. Most disappointing since in that sphere but did run well back over hurdles when secon
Recorded his sixth career success and a fourth over this C&D in small-field handicap in May. Capable fresh and is only 2 lb higher on this return to action.

Dual winner in the first half of last season, including this corresponding event. Returned to his best with his reappearance behind him when second at Southwell (3m) in June and not seen to best effect since, unsuited by

races.name: Alan & Sarah Laughterloft Legends Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: WOODVALE did well to overcome inexperience when making a winning start at Beverley and can defy a penalty. Havana Flash is the danger back over 5f on good to firm going.

runners.note: Mayson brother to smart sprinter Ainsdale. Overcome inexperience to land a gamble in 5f Beverley maiden on debut 3 weeks ago, green early but staying on well from off the strong gallop. Will improve and can defy a penalt
Well beaten in 2 novices.
€60,000 breeze-up purchase who has shown plenty of speed in 5f Musselburgh maiden and Redcar novice (not given a hard time). Can do better.

75,000 gns Kodiac colt. Brother to 2-y-o 5f-6f winner All The Time and half-brother to 6f winners Ballintogher and Beauty Light. 66/1, hinted at ability in 5f Windsor maiden 3 weeks ago. Should do better in time.
Form has been patchy but went close in a 5f Lingfield novice in June that worked out and she didn't get home faced with more testing ground back at 6f in a tongue tie at Chester last time. Dangerous.

races.name: Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not a strong maiden so QUEENS BANDIT is selected to build on the promise of her debut third at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. Lord Percy is also open to progress, while Tough Decision makes some appeal on pedigree.

runners.note: Foaled March 5. £10,000 yearling, Ten Sovereigns colt. Half-brother to 11.4f/1½m winner Bondi. Dam, Swedish 1½m winner, half-sister to useful winner abroad up to 1¾m Inaya. Shaped better than end result suggests when six

Foaled March 22. €3,000 yearling, £15,000 2-y-o (private sale), Ten Sovereigns colt. Dam, runner-up at 6f as a 2-y-o, closely related to useful winner up to 12.5f Preferential. Wore cheekpieces for debut and offered some

13,000 gns yearling, Space Blues gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to winner up to 7f Laulne. Showed a bit more than on debut when fourth at Wolverhampton (6f) 3 weeks ago but it's not form to be getting carried away with
Foaled February 28. Universal colt. Brother to 1m winner Fast Bullet. Dam, 7f winner, half-sister to useful 1¼m-1½m winner Lazzaro out of smart German 1m-11f winner Lacy. Newcomer of some interest.
50/1, eighth of 9 in novice at Kempton (1m) on debut 13 days ago, slowly away. Cheekpieces quickly applied.
Limited impact both starts and she's significantly up in trip after 3 months off.
Foaled March 3. Stradivarius filly. Dam 6f winner (including at 2 yrs).
Foaled February 16. Churchill filly. Closely related to Italian 11.5f winner Foxtrot Tango and half-sister to several winners, including useful winner up to 1¼m Like A Tiger.

7,000 gns yearling, Lope Y Fernandez filly. Half-sister to several winners, including useful winner up to 1m Royal Charter and 5f winner Al Hussar. Couldn't match her position at the head of the betting but it was a prom

races.name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: INTHENICKOFTIME made it 2 wins from 2 starts at this course when taking a big-field handicap last month and the runner-up has already franked that form. He makes plenty of appeal. Hello Garda and Just For One can also make their presence felt.

runners.note: Built on promise of previous run when winning 20-runner handicap hurdle over similar trip at this course last month. 7 lb higher now but looks sure to go well again.

Runner-up in a Sligo maiden hurdle for Ian Patrick Donoghue and also second in a bumper at Clonmel on his first 2 starts. However, his progress has since stalled and he shaped as if amiss when last seen at Wexford in May

Fairly useful bumper winner in 2024. Below that level over hurdles but took a step back in the right direction when fifth of 11 in handicap over similar trip at Cork last time. Capable of being involved.
Opened account over hurdles at Kilbeggan in May but failed to build on that since and arrives on back of poor effort on Flat. Tongue strap on first time.
Career best when winning 16-runner handicap hurdle at Tramore (2m, good to soft, 14/1) in April. Raised 6 lb since but will be dangerous if ready to roll on return.
Showed nothing back from a long absence in either start this year and can only be watched here.
Still looking for first success but has found improvement over longer trips in handicaps this season. Feasibly treated if bouncing back from a below-par effort at Sligo.

Belatedly opened account at Sligo in May and on another going day when third in big-field handicap at Kilbeggan last month. Not the most consistent, though, and underperformed at Navan last time. Others preferred.
Eleven-race maiden who has yet to fire this season and makes limited appeal despite figuring off a potentially attractive mark.
Off the mark at Uttoxeter (2m) in July and improved on that when excellent fourth of 11 in juvenile hurdle (11/1) at Listowel (2m, good) 16 days ago. Goes handicapping now and may have more to offer.
Sole success from 40 starts came here in 2024 but has rarely threatened since. Hard to enthuse over from 12 lb out of the handicap.

races.name: Christmas Parties 2026 At Huntingdon Racecourse Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: BROADWAY HONEY escapes a penalty for her impressive victory at Fontwell on Saturday and can make it 3-4 over fences for her red-hot stable. Carrigmoorna Rowan could be the danger starting out for a new trainer.

runners.note: Fair maiden hurdler for Ellmarie Holden in Ireland. Not been quite at that level over fences for new yard this season, although some of his recent form is working out fine and a speed test at this trip shouldn't outstret

Fair hurdler/chaser who ran several good races for Ryan Potter last season, including on return here 11 months ago and when going close at Fontwell (3¼m) on his final start. Worth a look for new trainer.

Has left her hurdles form well behind sent chasing in recent weeks, scoring in similar contest at Worcester and conditional jockeys handicap at Fontwell (3¼m) on Saturday. Escapes a penalty for that impressive success at
Opened account in 19f Warwick handicap hurdle in April. Not so good in 2 starts after but is the type to make a chaser, though he has a much longer trip to contend with on return.
Mixed record in Ireland for Shane Crawley but made an encouraging start for this yard when third at Bangor (3m) last month. Went the wrong way from that turned out quickly at Newton Abbot, however.

races.name: Mick & Linda New Inn Enderby Cheers Nursery
races.verdict: MA FILLE DE REVE was much improved upped to this trip when second at Thirsk 3 weeks ago and can surely win a race like this on that showing. Windsor winner Holliesthedollie and Secret Rival are a couple of the other key players.

runners.note: Won 6f Chepstow maiden in July and wasn't seen to best effect having been a lot shorter in the betting back down in grade and trip in 6f Thirsk nursery 3 weeks ago. One to note under new rider.

Improved with her sights lowered when opening account in 6f Windsor nursery 5 weeks ago, well placed and clear of the second who has won twice since. 5 lb rise within reach and should put up another bold showing.

Played up beforehand but took a step forward when 2½ lengths second of 7 in 5f Bath novice when last seen in May. That form has worked out well enough but she'll need to improve further to make an impact now handicapping
Has shown a fair bit in 6f/7f events, up with the sound pace throughout when fourth here (7f) 4 months ago. That form is good and he could have more to offer now handicapping having been gelded.
Well-bred filly who has shaped encouragingly in 5f Wolverhampton nurseries the last twice. Will benefit from this return to 6f and could take a hand.
Posted fair effort in the Albany at Royal Ascot but has rather gone backwards since. Bred to stay a lot further than this and opposable from high draw on handicap debut.
Modest maiden who attracted support but didn't fare much better in a first-time visor in 6f Catterick nursery 4 weeks ago. Another 2 lb drop not enough to tempt.
Well held in 6f novices (briefly looked reluctant but at no stage unduly punished at Salisbury 8 weeks ago). Has been gelded and could do better now handicapping.
Caught the eye in 6f Windsor novice on her third start but her form has stalled rather than progressed, always behind on handicap debut here (7f, Honeymoon Bear fourth) 4 weeks ago.

Has shown just a modest level of ability, doing quite a lot of running to get into the picture when beaten around 3 lengths on nursery debut here (7f) 4 weeks ago. That race has worked out quite well.
Twice runner-up in June but hasn't progressed in nurseries (tried blinkered when beaten 7 lengths at Thirsk latest). Tricky to fancy even with Billy Loughnane up.

Is still learning but ran her best race to place for the first time when third in 6f Southwell nursery 3 weeks ago, having to switch towards far side final 1f but keeping on. Has got more to offer if able to brush up on

Well backed for nursery debut and much improved when ¾-length second of 16 at Thirsk (6f) 3 weeks ago, pulling clear of the rest, including a couple of today's rivals. 4 lb rise fair and can win one of these on that show

Beaten just a head by subsequent winner on handicap debut at Chepstow (6f) in July but hasn't progressed, nearest finish in first-time tongue tie in strongly-run Bath nursery last week. Looks vulnerable.
Hasn't beaten a rival in 3 novices.

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Handicap
races.verdict: Hard to make a compelling case for any of these but SOUTH KENSINGTON is more than capable from this mark if on a going day so is awarded the vote in the hope there's a sound pace for her to chase. Rainbow Sign and King of The Dance are potential threats.

runners.note: Low-key start for this yard during the spring, including first start over 1¼m. Lower turf mark is justified.
A fair 7f scorer (albeit not straightforward) for Hugo Palmer who signed off for that yard with a good third at Wetherby in June. Not in same form in 3 starts for this stable, though.

Recorded a first success for present stable this season in handicap at Southwell in May. Right back on her game when runner-up at Lingfield but back on turf, she was never a factor at Redcar. Back up slightly in trip and
Second over 7f here in June but well held in 2 outings for new stable since.
Won at Chepstow in June and has pretty much held his form since, sticking on at the one pace when fifth on heavy ground at Ffos Las last week.
Kept busy this year and off the mark for the season at Ffos Las last month, all out. Not in the same form under a penalty despite finishing third back there last week.
Has paid his way at Les Landes again this summer, winning twice but he's normally opposable in races on the mainland.
Found his run of good form coming to a halt in recent weeks so bounce back called for.
Scored here this time last year and has made the frame on several occasions more recently, shaping as though still in good form over C&D a month ago. Can be a factor.
Remains a maiden, his issues at the stalls not helping his cause of late.
Placed at Bath last spring but more miss than hit since, albeit drop to classified company helped his cause when third over further here in August.

races.name: Guinness Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Having turned a C&D handicap into a one-sided affair last month, MOONSHINE GIRL hadn't been fully asked for her effort when slipping up at Listowel 11 days ago. Returned to this venue, she can get back on the up. Fire Coral won that aforementioned race and she will doubtless give it another good go, while Western Shores is a potential improver for her leading yard.

runners.note: Much improved since joining current yard, winning Ballinrobe handicap in July before defying an 11 lb rise in a 3m event at Roscommon in August by 5½ lengths from Mavetherave. Has failed to complete both starts since and

Won 3 times in the first half of last season and stopped the slide with cheekpieces applied when fourth of 12 in handicap hurdle at Downpatrick (19f) in June. Unable to match that at Kilbeggan since and she's not the for
Likeable mare who deservedly got off the mark for the season at Listowel 11 days ago, better than ever in the process. 8 lb rise does make life hard but she won back-to-back races last season.

Temperamental sort but dropped to last previous winning mark and seen to good effect when landing big-field handicap here a month ago (2¾m). Overall profile doesn't mark her out as an obvious follow-up contender for all
Signs of ability in her qualifying runs, again shaping like a stayer when fifth at Kilbeggan a month ago. Back up in trip for handicap debut and she likely has a bigger effort in her.

Found improvement in first-time blinkers when readily winning 19-runner C&D handicap hurdle last month. Runner-up that day successful since and wasn't out of it when slipping up at Listowel 11 days ago. This mark is with
Scope from this lowly mark on her bumper form but tongue tied, has failed to meet market expectations both starts in handicaps. Hood now added.

races.name: Book 2026/27 Hospitality At Huntingdon Racecourse Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A notably thin maiden and a good opportunity for the well-bred GOLDEN TIARA to get her Rules career off to the perfect start. Dancing Dame is the obvious threat.

runners.note: Fair form in bumpers and over hurdles in Ireland for Timothy Doyle. Found only one too good starting out for James Owen at Fakenham in May and should bounce back from a lesser effort at Newton Abbot the following month.

€45,000 3-y-o, Getaway mare. Half-sister to numerous winners, including Queen Mother Champion Chase winner Special Tiara and fairly useful hurdler Accidental Rebel. Dam unraced. Unplaced completed start in Irish points b
Regressive for Gordon Elliott last season and hasn't offered much in 2 starts for current yard since returning to action.
Winning pointer who went with little promise tongue tied in an Aintree bumper on sole outing for David Phelan in May.
Unplaced in bumpers and well held on recent Warwick hurdling debut (2m). Most likely one for the longer term.

races.name: British EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: ENGEDI left the impression she could improve significantly with her promising Beverley debut behind her and is taken to get off the mark. Caelan's Rose and Ozone Friendly are feared most.

runners.note: Promising type who posted a fair third of 9 in novice at Salisbury (1m, good to soft, 20/1) on debut 33 days ago. Should progress and is one for the shortlist.
Signs of ability amidst greenness when third of 8 in novice at Beverley on debut 20 days ago, not knocked about. Should have more to offer and merits consideration.
Foaled March 20. 50,000 gns yearling, Zarak filly. Closely related to useful 1¼m/10.2f winner Silver Lake and half-sister to winner up to 11f Trad Jazz. Interesting newcomer.
Unfancied in market and no real impact in novice at Kempton (7f) on debut 32 days ago. One for longer term.
Looked in need of experience when seventh of 10 in novice at Haydock (7f, soft) on debut 11 days ago. Likely to need more time.
Foaled April 19. Without Parole filly. Dam, Italian 1m-11.4f winner, half-sister to useful winner up to 1¾m Liszt. Market check advised on debut.
Posted promising second of 6 in novice at Lingfield (1m, AW) in August and ran to a similar level when fair fourth of 10 in maiden at Newmarket (7f, firm, 14/1) 10 days ago. Ought to go well again.
Foaled March 14. 27,000 gns yearling, Saxon Warrior filly. Dam once-raced sister to smart US 9f-11f winner Mondego. Noteworthy newcomer.
Signs of ability when fifth of 9 in novice at Southwell (7f) on debut 19 days ago, slowly away. Improvement required to play a part here, however.
Not knocked about when seventh of 12 in maiden (22/1) at Bath (1m, good to firm) on debut last month but is likely to need time and longer trips to be seen at her best.

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 40 Pound In Free Bets At matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict: Something of a repeat of last month's C&D contest with the first 4 on that occasion all back in opposition. Highland Harvey was second that day but is fancied to deservedly double his tally. With Bug Boy not sure to be in the same form this time, Clipsham Noble is feared most.

runners.note: Had a good Brighton record down the years and he came with a storming late run to end a lengthy losing sequence over C&D last month, proving just too strong for Highland Harvey despite a typically slow start. Task is to

Not the most straightforward but was an emphatic winner at Bath (11.5f) in May. Also successful over hurdles during the summer and runner-up back on the Flat the last twice, clear of the rest when edged out latest.
Went close twice in small-field handicaps last summer for Donald McCain. Quiet start for new yard in 2026, though.
Gained reward for a string of consistent efforts in 7-runner contest over similar trip to this at Bath 3 weeks ago. 4 lb rise still leaves her very competitive.
Benefited from a good ride when ending his losing run in a classified event at Lingfield (1½m) but never really looked like following up back in handicap company on final start for Pat Phelan.
Finally got off the mark in 11.5f classified event at Yarmouth in July. Good placed efforts all 6 starts since, including when runner-up to Bug Boy over C&D a month ago and can win a race like this.

Got off the mark for the year in last-gasp fashion in a 1½m classified event on all-weather in August. Ridden differently when not in quite the same form a week later but quickly back on his game when 1¾ lengths fourth o
Twice a winner at Leicester this season for his new yard, latest in 6-runner handicap in July. Has held his form well since and was also involved in the busy finish over C&D won by Bug Boy.
Typically given patient approach by his yard, no better than seventh in his qualifying runs spread out over a year. Handicaps a lot more suitable and market will be informative.
Quirky maiden who's been sent off at long odds on all previous starts, though she did at least run up to form when third at Wolverhampton on Friday.

races.name: BOYLE Sports Shop At Galway Racecourse Beginners Chase
races.verdict: An interesting race and with this trip looking more suitable for CAPTAIN RYAN MATT than the Willie Mullins-trained pair Road To Home (sets a useful standard) and Chart Topper, he could be the answer sent chasing.

runners.note: Much improved when notching second hurdles success at Tramore on New Year's Day and he backed that up when fourth of 21 at the Aintree Festival. Needs taking very seriously on chase bow for his successful stable.

Was in the process of running a cracker when falling in Pertemps Qualifier at Haydock in February. Cheekpieces quickly discarded after a heavy defeat at Cheltenham and right back on his game when third in a deeper handic

Fairly useful hurdler, successful twice early last season at up to 2½m and also second in the Grade 2 Persian War at Chepstow. Beaten by more than lack of stamina for 3m on chase debut in June but he's definitely in the
Winless since debut back in 2024 but plenty of useful efforts to his name over hurdles. Not quite at that level over fences last season and he looks vulnerable.
Left Gordon Elliott after finishing mid-division in a handicap hurdle at the Punchestown Festival in April and was always behind returned to fences at Sligo.

Has yet to win over fences but went very close with an excellent neck second of 23 to Ask Brewster in Kim Muir at Cheltenham (3¼m) and more than matched that form when third in another valuable handicap at Sandown in the

Was fortunate when winning a maiden hurdle at Down Royal last season. Got back on track following a break when sixth on his handicap debut at Fairyhouse in April. Successful on his only start in points but he was never r

Point winner who made a successful start over hurdles in 12-runner Navan maiden (2¾m, heavy) in January. Better form when second at Navan and better than bare facts of Ayr run in April. Should do well over the larger obs

Improved when second at Gowran in February on his final start for Adrian Murray and went one better on first outing for John McConnell at Wexford the following month. Switched yards again after but just mid-field in a ha

races.name: 2026/2027 Annual Badges Now On Sale At Huntingdon Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: INCA shaped quite encouragingly on first run for his new yard when fourth at Worcester last month and could be the answer if building on that in a first-time tongue strap. Clever Relation could be the danger if not caught out by the shorter trip.

runners.note: Isn't the most robust, but put a poor run straight behind him when third in 13-runner handicap at Uttoxeter (2m, good) 3 weeks ago, finishing lame. Hood refitted and not sure to be suited by this step back up in trip.
Has shown little since winning at Exeter last October, including after 11 weeks off at Newton Abbot in August. Could only consider if backed. NON RUNNER.
Tumbled in weights since winning 4-runner event over C&D in May last year and failed to build on the promise of his last run when only seventh of 9 in 2½m handicap at Worcester latest.
Resumed from an 8-week break when runner-up at this venue here (20.7f) in May. However, failed to repeat that effort at Stratford and again ran below form at Fontwell last time. Tongue tie refitted.
NON RUNNER.

Returned to form to win from 4 lb out of the weights in 5-runner selling handicap hurdle at Newton Abbot (17f, good) last week, driven clear. Has more on his plate under a 7-lb penalty on first run for yard after leaving

Fair Flat winner for Hughie Morrison. Made more impact than previously over hurdles when second of 6 in handicap at Fontwell (2¾m, good) 30 days ago, suited by increase in trip and also how the race developed. Has the sa
Lightly-raced 4-y-o from good yard. Easy to back and fared little better than previously when down the field on handicap bow at Fontwell (19f) when last seen in June.

Shaped quite encouragingly on first run since leaving Clare Hobson when fourth of 9 in handicap hurdle at Worcester (2½m, good to soft) 26 days ago. Definite chance if building on that in a first-time tongue strap.

races.name: Everards Of Leicestershire Handicap
races.verdict: It could be worth chancing SEVEN QUESTIONS before the benefit of market clues. The 2024 Palace House winner has found life tough since landing a gamble at Goodwood in May but has dropped to a career-low mark consequently and could be set for a revival with Billy Loughnane up back at a track where he won easily on his only other visit. Forager came clear readily at Bath last week and has obvious cl

runners.note: Successful at Newcastle in November and January but has returned to turf with 2 heavy defeats. First go in a 0-85 and has a bit to prove.

Successful twice this year, taking advantage of a drop into this grade at York in July. Back to his best when ½-length second to a lightly-raced one ahead of his mark in a similar event at Southwell a fortnight ago, and
Won 5f handicaps at Musselburgh and Doncaster (under this claimer) this summer and latest run at Ripon can be ignored (raced alone on far side from low draw). Wouldn't dismiss.

Back in top form and was a shade unlucky to lose his unbeaten record at Beverley 3 weeks ago, having to wait for a gap over 1f out and collared at the death. Back up 3 lb (last win off this mark) and can go well from sta
Completed a hat-trick in 5f handicaps on firm/good to firm ground this summer and might have needed his recent run at Newmarket (6f) after 7 weeks off. Could show more back over the minimum trip now.

2024 Palace House winner has struggled since scoring at Goodwood (5f) in May, but down in class now having dropped to a career-low mark and was successful on his only other run at Leicester. A revival could be imminent u
Confirmed previous promise and produced a career-best effort to notch a fifth success in clear-cut fashion in 5f Bath handicap last week. Serious player under a penalty.

Made all at Yarmouth in April and best effort since when going close at Lingfield penultimate start. Never involved from worst of the draw at York 10 weeks ago and could fare better here back from a break.

Won both her starts at 2 yrs and best effort this season when second of 6 from an unpromising position in handicap at Lingfield (5f, all-weather) in August. Easy to back and not so good at Beverley next time, however.

Won back-to-back 5f nurseries at Newcastle to end 2025. Form mixed this year, going close at Thirsk and Beverley this summer but not so good in 2 runs 24 hours apart last month (wore first-time cheekpieces latest). More

Successful on his only other run here and has won 3 times at a lower level this year, including at Nottingham in July. Has struggled in better company last 3 starts (one of the first off the bridle in refitted cheekpiece

races.name: Matchbook Monthly Bet-Builder Rebate Handicap
races.verdict: OXFORD CIRCUS failed to meet market expectations starting out for James Owen but he did have an excuse and from this basement mark, he's well worth siding with. Berning Hot and Burford Beauty (starting out for an up-and-coming stable) are definite threats.

runners.note: Low-mileage filly who posted her best effort of the season when second of 5 in 6f handicap at Windsor in April. Could manage only mid-field over the same C&D a month later and cheekpieces are now reached for eased in cla

Shaped better than the result over C&D in August and off the mark for the season back here 19 days later. Continued the very good work when second returned to 1m at Lingfield (all-weather) and no reason why she won't get
Failed to win a race for Gavin Cromwell in Ireland but shaped well a few times in better races than this one. Joined a capable stable and market will be informative on return from 73 days off.
All 3 career victories at Brighton and runner-up 3 times here this season. Also found only one too strong at Doncaster in July but a couple of shockers have followed since. Visor replaces blinkers.
Losing run dates back over 2 years and more miss than hit in 2026, albeit one of her 2 runner-up efforts was gained over this C&D. Big price and dropped away on recent stable debut. Visor now fitted.

Showed a willing attitude when off the mark for this yard in a 6f handicap here in September 2025. Dropped in the weights, so really should be a factor but was brushed aside here in August. Given a short break.
Sole win came in 2024 but 2 runner-up efforts over 1m at this track in recent weeks confirm he's very competitive at this level. Last week's C&D fifth was just a respectable run, though.
Resumed winning ways in classified event over C&D in June but not been in same form since. Cheekpieces back on returned to handicap company.
Chelmsford winner from higher mark a year ago. Rather in-and-out since and profile is a slightly more compelling one on all-weather.

Won at Dundalk in February before losing way in headgear on turf after. Never looked like justifying support starting out for James Owen at Lingfield but reportedly resented the kickback and is well worth another chance.

races.name: Ryans Cleaning Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict: ONEFORTHEDITCH made the frame in her last 2 starts over fences and her prominent style of racing should be suited to this track. She gets the nod. Dunany Point and Dearg Mor are also of interest.

runners.note: Underlined positive start for current stable when winning 11-runner 2½m handicap chase at Limerick in May but has largely disappointed since. Cheekpieces back on. Others more convincing.
Fair winning hurdler who has gone with no encouragement in 3 starts over fences. Goes handicapping with lots to prove.
Fair form over hurdles at best but hasn't matched that level in 5 starts over fences this season, well held at Downpatrick latest. Drops back in grade here but others make more appeal.

Consistent mare who got back to winning ways at Limerick in December and ran creditably in defeat thereafter, including when sixth of 24 in handicap hurdle at Punchestown when last seen in April. Returns to chasing off m

Improved form over hurdles when making the frame in handicaps at around 3m on first 2 outings this season. Strong in the betting but stumbled soon after the start when below-par fourth of 16 at Kilbeggan in July. Interes
Not the most consistent and is still looking for first success after 20 NH runs. Fairly treated if on a going day, though.
Just sole success from 21 starts but returned to form when good second of 15 in handicap chase over longer trip at Sligo 6 days ago. Remains feasibly treated and enters calculations.
Yet to score under Rules and was too free when well beaten over longer trip at Wexford on debut over fences 39 days ago. Improvement required.

Stepped up markedly on his comeback run earlier in the year when staying on strongly to win handicap hurdle at Limerick (2m) in April and ran respectably, back from 4 months off in similar race at Listowel last time. Ran
Found improvement to open his account over hurdles at Sligo in August and may have been left with too much to do when fifth in Roscommon follow-up bid last week. Warrants respect on chasing bow.

Supported at long odds when winning handicap hurdle on second start for Denis Hogan at Wexford in July. Now switches to fences having struggled off higher marks since and is worth monitoring in the market.

A 5-time winner, who registered the last of those successes over hurdles at Tipperary this time last year. However, yet to prove as effective over fences (well-in on hurdles form) and her record when fresh is mixed at be

races.name: Host Your Conference At Huntingdon Racecourse Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DELPOTRO arrives in good form and there's every chance he could get away on the front end, especially if able to dictate, which tilts the vote in his favour over Datsalrightcharlie, who is likely to find this test on the sharp side. Mavis Pike retains potential as a chaser returning from a 10-month absence so warrants respect, particularly with the Twiston-Davies yard amongst the winners.

runners.note: Reached a fairly useful level with 5 victories over hurdles. Yet to match that form over fences, though one of better efforts in this sphere when second of 5 at Uttoxeter (2½m) in July and easy to excuse latest run back

Front runner who confirmed his return to form when third in 8-runner handicap at Sedgefield (19f, good to firm) in late August. Didn't go down without a fight once headed between the last 2 there and will be dangerous if

Dual hurdles winner who was in the process of improving on her chasing debut when falling at the last at Fakenham (21.2f, good to soft) last October. Exited through no fault of her own at Warwick next time and retains po

Maiden hurdle winner at Exeter last autumn and good third in Ascot novice next start. However, has shown little all 3 starts this season, including in this sphere, and hopes now pinned on first-time cheekpieces having th

Landed the odds in a weak maiden on hurdling debut here in March 2025. Failed to kick on in that sphere last season but made an encouraging enough start over fences when third of 4 in 3m handicap here when last seen in M

races.name: Paul & Margo Barley Mow Cosgrove Farewell Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: SOLARIZE is lightly raced for his age and added another victory to his tally at Southwell a fortnight ago. Still fairly treated, he is taken to score again. Percy's Daydream and Ruby Wedding rate the principal dangers.

runners.note: Won a 1¼m handicap at Chester in July before finishing mid-field in a stronger race at Glorious Goodwood. Seemingly gone off the boil since but is now below his last winning mark.
Bagged third win from 7 starts when taking 10-runner handicap at Southwell (1½m) 14 days ago. Just 3 lb higher on turf debut and holds strong claims.

Returned to winning form with success in 1¼m handicap at Chester in July and back on track when good third of 8 in handicap (14/1) at Newbury (1¼m, good to firm) 18 days ago, faring best of those held up. Respected.
Off the mark at Hamilton earlier this summer and added to that victory at Salisbury (1½m) in August. Latest run can be excused (too keen) and can't be ruled out here.

Successful twice this season, including when making all at Beverley in June. Returned to form more recently, latest when creditable third of 12 in handicap at Redcar (1¼m, good to soft) 13 days ago. Likely player.
Found improvement, back from 5 months off, when excellent second of 10 in handicap (8/1) over shorter trip at Newmarket 11 days ago. Just 1 lb higher now and is not taken lightly. NON RUNNER.

races.name: Play Your Multiples at matchbook.com Handicap
races.verdict: MY MATE MACKLEY and Candy Warhol filled the first 2 positions in a C&D handicap last week and it would be no surprise were that to happen again. Beach Partee can also go well for Scott Dixon, while Everydaysasaturday needs a check in the market.

runners.note: Is 0-15 and latest Windsor run was a big backward step after finishing placed on 4 of 5 starts prior to that. This is the weakest band of handicap he's contested, though.

On a long losing sequence but several good in-frame efforts to his name, giving a good account from the front when length second of 8 to My Mate Mackley in handicap over C&D 8 days ago. Blinkers replace usual cheekpieces
Fitted with cheekpieces when getting off the mark at Lingfield in May and returned to a similar level when making all at Chepstow (6f) in August. Unable to continue the good work twice since.

Usual cheekpieces back on and proved better than ever when winning 8-runner handicap over C&D 8 days ago by length from Candy Warhol. That was a third win and this consistent sort is a must for the shortlist.
Low-key starts in handicaps for Declan Carroll at up to 7f. Left that yard and interesting to see what Tony Carroll can do with him. Market will be useful.
Won 3 times as a juvenile (including here). Yet to score as a 3-y-o but arrives on the back of a quartet of creditable efforts. Can remain competitive.
Sole victory came back in 2024 for Charlie Fellowes. Best effort for this stable when second at Lingfield in March but below form in his 5 subsequent outings.
Belatedly off the mark in a 7f classified event at this track in August. Sound-enough second at that level back over 6f at Yarmouth but slightly more on his plate returned to a handicap.
Brighton regular who enters the reckoning on a series of placed efforts in 2025. Yet to get going this season, however.
Third at Kempton in March but little to recommend since, albeit latest Lingfield run isn't a race to judge her harshly on.

races.name: Mongey Communications Handicap Chase
races.verdict: HEES DYNAMITE finished with running left under an inexperienced rider at Listowel last time and remains well treated on his hurdles form. He gets the vote with Darragh O'Keeffe up now. Ballagh Star was another eyecatcher at Sligo last week and demands respect off 2 lb lower. Thursday's Clonmel hurdles winner Mount Shenshan and Juke Hill are also respected.

runners.note: A 5-time winner, including over C&D. On a good mark on the pick of his hurdles form and shaped well in 3m amateur handicap at Listowel last time, caught further back than the other principals under his inexperienced ride

Point winner who remains with one standout effort under Rules, that coming on his first go over fences when third of 12 in novice chase at Kilbeggan (2½m) in June. Has been dropped 4 lb but he needs to show more.

Fair handicap hurdler who got off the mark at Limerick (21f, heavy) in February. Has become increasingly unreliable, though, and made an underwhelming chasing debut after 4 months off at Ballinrobe. Switched to a handica
Always looked like he'd do well over fences and produced his best effort since his chasing debut at Perth (3m) last time, though still lacked a punch at the business end. Can find a race.
Has gone the wrong way since his novice days when successful at Navan and turned in a particularly sour display at Kilbeggan last time, going in snatches and always behind. Change of headgear.

Kept mistakes to a minimum when winning 14-runner handicap chase at Killarney in May. Below that level since, soon backing out of things after briefly moving into contention between 3 out and 2 out in C&D event a month a

3m maiden hurdle winner lightly raced under Rules in recent times. Placed twice in points earlier this year (long-standing maiden in that sphere). Subject of an interesting stable switch having joined Shark Hanlon and wo
Much improved when winning 23f handicap chase at Ballinrobe last month by 20 lengths. Pulled up lame at Sligo on Wednesday and back out again quickly in first-time cheekpieces.

Ended a long losing run in 2½m Clonmel mares handicap hurdle on Thursday, doing well to overcome the run of the race. Is of a similar class over fences, albeit 0-13, and goes off the same mark here, though isn't an obvio

Gambled on in new headgear and shaped as if back to form bidding to win 3¼m Sligo handicap chase for a third time last week, inconvenienced by marathon run-in that day due to low sun and much better than the bare result.

races.name: Advertise At Huntingdon Racecourse In 2026/2027 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FLOW RIVER FLOW appeals on paper and the booking of Sean Bowen catches the eye, so he's taken to make a winning start. Snicket for last year's winning yard and Bran Galad are other likely types on breeding and need taking seriously, especially if the subject of strong market support.

runners.note: Without Parole gelding. Half-brother to 1m winner Bonaventure. Dam, maiden on Flat (stayed 1m), half-sister to fairly useful hurdler (stayed 3¼m) Imphal.
Camelot gelding. Dam 1½m winner. One of the likelier types on paper.

Camelot gelding. Half-brother to fairly useful hurdler Balboa, stays 25f, and fair hurdler Global Skies. Dam 7f-10.4f winner. Has to be taken seriously, especially with Champion Jockey Sean Bowen booked.
Masterstroke gelding. Half-brother to 5f winner Metal Exchange. Dam lightly raced on Flat in France.
1,000 gns 3-y-o, Mirage Dancer gelding. Half-brother to 1m winner Celtic John. Dam 7f-1¼m winner who stayed 1½m. A cheap purchase and others look more persuasive.
Lope Y Fernandez gelding. Half-brother to modest hurdler Pottersmattyeeehaa. Dam (b88) bumper winner, also 11.5f winner who stayed 1¾m on Flat.

18,000 gns 3-y-o, Pinatubo gelding. Closely related to a winner on Flat and half-brother to 2 winners, including fair hurdler Maple. Dam 10.5f winner in France. Much respected newcomer for yard that won this race last ye
Cotai Glory gelding. Half-brother to Italian hurdler Ladise. Dam placed on Flat. Needs a market check for up-and-coming yard.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Price Boosts Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: ZAFAAN had plenty in the tank when going in at Wolverhampton last week and is hard to side against turned out under a penalty with Henry Callan now in the saddle. Recent Newcastle scorer West Sleekburn Lad could emerge as the main danger with this step up in trip a likely positive, although both Beaune and Stitching Wheel can also play a prominent role in this competitive amateur riders handicap.

runners.note: Scored at Redcar in June and in good nick since, making effort earlier than ideal when fifth of 6 in handicap at Newmarket (1¾m, good to firm) in August. Well in the mix eased 1 lb with Simon Walker in the saddle.
Back-to-back winner last September for Iain Jardine. Well below his best this season though for 3 different yards, last of 9 over 11f here on yard debut 19 days ago.
A 3-time all-weather winner early in 2026. Largely running well of late until tenth of 12 in handicap at Chester (2m, soft) last time. Could bounce back off a handy-looking mark.
In fine form of late, following up hurdles win at Worcester with very easy success in 10-runner handicap at Wolverhampton (1¾m) 8 days ago. Big shout under a penalty with Henry Callan up.
Good second in amateur race at Wolverhampton in February but has struggled on turf more recently. Needs to take a step forward in refitted cheekpieces.
Scored over hurdles at Carlisle and posted a solid third of 11 in handicap here later in April. Not dismissed after a break though.
Eleven runs since last win in 2024. Blinkered for first time (usually visored) when a respectable third of 11 in handicap at Windsor (11.5f, good) 22 days ago. Back up in trip and not ruled out.
Not the most reliable but in a good vein of form at present, second of 9 in 11f handicap here 19 days ago. Possibilities.
Twice runner-up in all-weather handicaps this summer but she failed to beat a rival in handicap at Windsor (11.5f, good) 22 days ago. Has a bit to prove now.

Lightly-raced son of Golden Horn who took a big step forward on his handicap bow when winning 11-runner event at Newcastle (1½m) 17 days ago. Up 5 lb but he's a player with this longer trip a likely plus and Eireann Cagn
Best effort when second in Lingfield classified event (1½m, all-weather) in July but a well-held seventh of 9 back there 26 days ago. Bounce back needed.
Limited maiden. Not discredited when sixth of 11 to West Sleekburn Lad in handicap at Newcastle (1½m) last time. Others appeal more.

races.name: Mario & Traci Plough Duxford Last Orders Handicap
races.verdict: MAGIC MUSIC looked unlucky not to win here a fortnight ago and can make amends. Red Snapper and Travel Agent are a couple of others to consider.

runners.note: Has won at Ayr and Redcar over this trip in recent months but was below his best at Southwell 10 days ago. Back in a 0-70 with Billy Loughnane (form figures of 210 on him) up and can get back on track.

Took 17 runs to get off the mark but suddenly improved in the summer, completing a hat-trick at Nottingham in June after 2 C&D victories. Too free starting out for new yard (left Pam Sly for 6,000 gns) at Southwell 10 da

Showed a good attitude in a refitted visor when opening account for the year in 13-runner 6f apprentice handicap at Windsor (6f) last month. Unpenalised and not so good back there a week later but still on a fair mark on
Got off the mark in 7f Doncaster handicap in June and probably unlucky not to add to that in C&D handicap a fortnight ago, just failing having met trouble. Good shout under similar conditions.

Has been rejuvenated by the fitting of blinkers, scoring at Salisbury and Chepstow before a fine second back at the former track (no match for easy winner, beat the rest handily). Strong contender off the same mark.
Recorded back-to-back victories on all-weather in April. Hasn't had the rub of the green the last twice, including behind Magic Music here last time, and is back below his last winning mark.
Has won over C&D but been operating below her best in recent starts, including when dropped into 0-60 company for the first time in over 3 years at Ffos Las a fortnight ago.

races.name: Download The Matchbook Exchange App Handicap
races.verdict: In the hope he can break on terms this time, DONTSPOILASALE is taken to cash in on what is a very handy mark. Diomed Spirit and Roman Spring have plenty of C&D wins between them and head the opposition.

runners.note: Bagged an uncontested lead on the rail when taking advantage of a falling mark at Lingfield (6f) in July. Slow start didn't help her cause when below form here next time but also needs to cast aside another lesser effort

Free-going sort who doubled his tally at Southwell in May (5f). Not easy to catch right since however, having dropped to that winning mark, he stuck to his task well when third of 7 over the aforementioned C&D 12 days ag

Registered a third success of 2026 at Nottingham (5f) in July but seemed anchored by revised mark in a quartet of starts since on turf/all-weather. Way she stuck to it at Sandown 3 weeks ago suggests this sharp 5f may no
Transformed by first-time cheekpieces when doubling his tally in 8-runner event at Ffos Las (5f, soft) in June but hasn't reproduced that level in 6 subsequent starts.

Multiple 5f/6f winner in Ireland. Being brought along gradually since joining this yard and caught the eye when seventh of 11 in 7f handicap at Lingfield last month. Blew the start at Kempton and that is a worry but he's
Returned to form for new yard of late, runner-up in a big-field 6f handicap here flanked by C&D victories. Had a bit up his sleeve latterly so major player after latest 4 lb rise.
Placed 4 times this season but last trio of efforts have not been good, failing to exploit a drop in grade at Windsor 3 weeks ago after dwelling at the start. Assessor giving him every chance.
Off the mark for the year at Chepstow in June and quickly resumed winning ways here in August, his fifth C&D success. However, undone by revised mark since.

Back to front-running tactics when landing 11-runner handicap at Windsor and had the race sewn up a fair way out when following up over C&D last week. Penalty makes life harder but dangerous if getting into another nice

races.name: Race In Pink On October 25th Flat Race
races.verdict: WAY WITH WORDS produced a promising first effort when runner-up to a now useful sort at Leopardstown in March and has to be considered the one to beat on that form. Ellen Imlach is a noteworthy newcomer from a top stable, while Birdie Conway caught the eye finishing with running left in a valuable event at Punchestown on her debut and also enters calculations.

runners.note: Sea Moon gelding. Dam unraced half-sister to modest hurdler/fair chase winner (2½m-21f winner) Mr Bercow. Makes little appeal on paper.

Camacho gelding who proved easy to back but showed ability when fourth of 13 in bumper at Roscommon on debut in early August, the emphasis on speed suiting. Fared best of those held up at Navan (1m) subsequently and shou
Australia gelding. Dam 1m winner in US. Others more appealing on paper.

€3,000 3-y-o, Jukebox Jury gelding. Dam, pulled up in points, half-sister to bumper winner/fairly useful 2½m hurdle winner Turn Turk. A cheap purchase but in good hands and would enter the reckoning if supported in the b
Poet's Word gelding. Dam 1m-1½m winner. Produced a promising first effort when runner-up to a useful rival in 8-runner bumper at Leopardstown (2m, soft) in March and is the form pick.

Jet Away filly. Dam unraced sister to Champion Bumper winner The Mourne Rambler. Shaped like a stayer when sixth of 19 in valuable sales bumper at Punchestown (17f) on debut in April, finishing with running left. Entitle
Bathyrhon filly. Half-sister to useful hurdler/very smart chaser Ash Tree Meadow and fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser Darcy Ward. Noteworthy newcomer.
Crystal Ocean filly who is a half-sister to useful hurdler Alletrix. Check the market for clues.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bookmaker Comparison EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not much form to go on and it could pay to side with the well-related Iffraaj filly LADY'S GRACE to make a winning start. Jahami seems sure to build on a promising debut third at Newcastle and rates a big threat, while Thespian Queen could also play a part if shrugging off a lesser effort at Goodwood.

runners.note: Mayson filly took a step forward from her debut with fourth of 5 in novice at Ayr (7f, heavy) 17 days ago. May do better still.
3/1, third of 10 in maiden at Newcastle (6f) on debut 17 days ago, not knocked about. This Twilight Son filly should have more to offer for leading yard, especially over this longer trip.

Foaled February 9. Iffraaj filly. Sister to very smart/unreliable winner up to 1m Audience and half-sister to several winners, including winner up to 7f Esquire. Dam 6f-7f winner. Interesting newcomer for top connections

Foaled February 19. €30,000 yearling, Saxon Warrior filly. Dam, French 1m winner, half-sister to high-class winner up to 1½m The Fugue out of useful 9f winner (stayed 1¾m) Twyla Tharp. Appeals on paper but the market can
Foaled February 10. Ubettabelieveit filly. Dam maiden half-sister to very smart 7f/1m winner Docklands and smart 1¼m-1½m winner Ickymasho. Likely best watched on debut.
Went backwards from a promising debut Kempton (7f) second when sixth of 13 in novice at Goodwood (1m, good to soft) 38 days ago. Worth another chance after a break.
17/2 and tongue strap on, twelfth of 13 in maiden at Beverley (7.3f, heavy) on debut 38 days ago. Plenty more is needed from this Ardad filly.
Foaled February 27. Tasleet filly. Half-sister to 1m winner Beaming Light and 1m winner Spec of Light. Others are preferred on this occasion.
Foaled April 22. Lope Y Fernandez filly. Half-sister to useful 2-y-o 5f winner Mrs Danvers. Dam, 2-y-o 5f winner, half-sister to smart winner up to 7f Izzthatright. One to note in the betting.
Foaled April 25. 10,000 gns foal, Tip Two Win filly. Half-sister to smart French/Australian 9f-1¾m winner Future History and 5f winner Shes Got A Brother. The betting can prove an accurate indicator.

Minzaal filly who finished second in barrier trial at Leopardstown. Similar form in a pair of 7f maidens last month, fourth at Down Royal then sixth of 15 at Naas. Can do better once qualified for handicaps.
Foaled April 29. €22,000 yearling, £5,000 2-y-o, Minzaal filly. Half-sister to several winners, including useful 1¼m-1¾m winner Okool and French 1¼m winner Castle of May.
50/1, seventh of 10 in 6f maiden at Newcastle on debut 17 days ago. Needs to build on it.
NON RUNNER.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bet Smarter Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: PIAZZA arrives better than ever and is taken to double her tally on the back of a very good Wolverhampton second when beaten just a head having been forced wide on the home turn. Lightly-raced Kempton winner Encore rates a big threat going into handicaps for the first time for William Haggas, while the consistent pair Korbut and Crafty Blue also need factoring in.

runners.note: Dual 6f scorer last season. Winless and not proving easy to catch right this season, failing to get home when fifth of 7 in handicap at Sandown (7f, good to soft) 25 days ago. Makes tapeta debut.

A 5-time course winner. Best effort of the campaign when second at Newcastle (6f) in September but failed to build on it with ninth of 13 in 6f handicap here 10 days ago. Often a slow starter and needs things to drop her

Kickstarted 2026 with success at Kempton (6f) in April. Has founds things much tougher since and tenth of 14 in handicap at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 17 days ago, only making late gains and never on terms.

Proving very consistent and gained a deserved breakthrough success in maiden at Ffos Las (7f) in August. Solid efforts back in handicap company since when second over 7f here and fifth of 10 at Wolverhampton (6f) 18 days

Built on earlier promise (trained debut by Ed Walker) when readily landing the odds in 8-runner novice at Kempton (6f) 22 days ago. Well bred and goes into handicaps with more to offer after just 3 runs. Likely player.

Successful in 7f Wolverhampton maiden in April. In and out since switched to handicaps since, coming in a below-par fifth of 9 at Wolverhampton (8.5f) when last seen in July.  Visor goes on for first time after a break.

Progressive sort who opened her account at Kempton (7f) in August and has finished runner-up at Yarmouth (1m) and Wolverhampton (7f) since, edged out only late on latter occasion having been forced wide home turn. Big sh
Doubled her tally in 6f handicap at Leicester in July. Has continued in good form, twice runner-up before fifth of 12 in handicap at Windsor (1m, good) 22 days ago. Holds solid claims.
Forward-going type who scored at Ayr (1m) and Carlisle (7f) in May. Rather in and out since though, only eighth of 11 in handicap at Ayr (1m, soft) 18 days ago.

Made the frame for the third start running when fourth in 7f Catterick maiden in August. Beat only one however on handicap bow in 11-runner event at Ayr (1m, soft) 18 days ago so bounce back is needed.
Dual 1m winner here early in 2026. Good second at Wolverhampton (7f) in August but well held both runs since, ninth of 12 in 1m handicap here latest.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Top UK Bookmakers EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ENGRAVED found the jump up to listed class too tough an ask at Doncaster last time and James Fanshawe's charge is taken to belatedly confirm debut promise by getting off the mark here. One For Bruce started well when third at Newmarket and appeals as the chief threat with progress very much on the cards, although newcomers Unerring and Sayaarr could also have a say, especially if the market speaks

runners.note: Off 3 months (gelded/breathing operation) and fitted with cheekpieces when seventh of 11 in 6f novice here 12 days ago. May do better still with that run under his belt.
Australia gelding has been well held in 1m novices at Windsor and Pontefract this summer. Lots more is needed.

200,000 gns breeze-up purchase. Made a promising start with second in 7f Ffos Las maiden in August but stiff task when well held in listed race at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) 25 days ago. Remains with potential back in
Well-related St Mark's Basilica colt but well held in 7f novices at Epsom and Ffos Las last month. The sort to do better in due course.
Kodiac colt shaped encouragingly when third of 7 in novice at Newcastle (7f, 11/8) on his debut 31 days ago. Clearly thought capable of better and not out of things.

Kingman colt showed promise when a debut fourth in maiden at Lingfield (6f, all-weather) but seemed ill-at-ease on track when sixth of 14 in maiden at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago. Remains open to improvement
Foaled May 1. Space Blues colt. Closely related to useful 2-y-o 7f winner Desert Order. Noteworthy newcomer, especially if the market vibes are positive.
Sent off 5/2 when a promising debut third of 6 in novice at Newmarket (6f, good) in August, running on when hampered late on. This son of Ubettabelieveit seems sure to build on it. Likely player.
Foaled March 2. A'ali colt. Dam 6f-7.6f winner. The betting can prove an accurate indicator for this newcomer.
Foaled April 12. 170,000 gns yearling, Dark Angel colt. Brother to French 2-y-o 5.5f/6f winner Kumite and half-brother to 5f winner Al Wosol. In good hands and appeals on paper so needs considering.
Promising initial third in 7f Goodwood maiden but went backwards when well held in another 7f maiden at York later in August. Worth another chance.
Fair form when in the frame on his first 4 starts but a below-par ninth of 15 in sales event at the Curragh (6f, good to soft) last time. Makes all-weather debut with cheekpieces back on.
Foaled March 13. Camelot colt. Brother to useful 2-y-o 8.6f winner Alexandroupolis and also a half-brother to 6f winner Music Banner. Hooded for debut but represents top yard and must be of interest.
22/1, last of 7 in 7f novice at Newcastle on debut 31 days ago. Significantly more is required from this Invincible Spirit colt.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Bet Smarter Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: INSUSPENSE was quick to make her mark for the switch to Ross Burdon over C&D last time and can make light of a 5 lb rise given she was well on top at the finish. Recent Newcastle scorer Storm Esme appeals as the one to chase her home, with Black Orchid completing the shortlist.

runners.note: Lightly-raced sort who made a winning return in 6f novice at Ripon in August. Backed it up with a good second of 5 in handicap at Redcar (5f, good to firm) 3 weeks ago. May do better still so needs considering back up in
Scored at Catterick (6f) in April and largely in good form since, though she came in last of 9 there (5f, good) last time. Needs to bounce back.
NON RUNNER.
Front runner who got off the mark in 7f maiden at Thirsk in July. Solid third in handicap at Chepstow (7f) next time but came in last of 10 in the mud at Haydock (7f) latest. Could bounce back.
Ardad filly is proving consistent and was runner-up for the fourth time in 6-runner novice here (5f) 33 days ago. Winner has gone in again since so she's not out of things on her handicap debut.
Bounced back to form (cheekpieces refitted) to land 14-runner handicap at Newcastle (6f) 31 days ago. Up 6 lb but travelled smoothly there and can go well again with headgear retained.
Opened her account at Kempton (6f) in September but only tenth of 12 in handicap at Yarmouth (6f, good) 20 days ago. Needs to get back on track.
Reliable sort who got off the mark (on just her second run for current yard) in good style in 13-runner handicap over C&D 19 days ago. Up 5 lb but another bold showing is on the cards.
Twice placed in 5f handicaps at Wolverhampton but a below-form fifth of 9 in 6f maiden there when last seen out 10 months ago for Roger Varian. Needs to hit the ground running for her new handler.
It's now thirteen runs since her last success in 2025 but she posted a creditable second of 12 to a thriving one in handicap over C&D last time. This C&D winner needs considering.
C&D winner but she's an unreliable sort overall. Recorded a creditable third of 10 in 6f handicap at Wolverhampton 15 days ago and needs to back it up now.
Failed to go on for Dylan Cunha but got off the mark on her third run for current yard under front-running tactics in 12-runner handicap over C&D 2 weeks ago. Not out of things despite a 4 lb rise.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Racing Offers Handicap
races.verdict: Multiple C&D scorer POPULAR DREAM signalled he is ready to strike again on his second run back after an absence when fifth over C&D on Saturday so looks the way to go. Khabib also has winning form over C&D and is feared most on the back of a good Newcastle third, while in-form duo Tommie's Angel and Jungle Dance need factoring in too.

runners.note: Proved consistent without winning for Ian Williams early in 2026. Well below par (around 1m) all 3 runs for Steph Hollinshead this summer though. Needs another yard switch to spark a revival over this much shorter trip.

Gained a fourth C&D win in January. Off 4 months, back in good nick of late and didn't enjoy a smooth passage when a close fifth of 10 over C&D 3 days ago. Bold showing on the cards turned out quickly off an unchanged ma
It's now thirteen runs since his last win in 2023 and he's offered little in a trio of runs this summer, seventh of 9 in handicap over C&D 10 days ago.
On a long losing sequence but he arrives in good nick, third of 8 in 5f handicap at Newcastle 11 days ago. This C&D winner can make his presence felt off a 2 lb lower mark.
Remains a maiden but she bounced back to form with third of 9 in handicap over C&D 10 days ago. Needs to reproduce it here.

Largely struggled for form in 2025 but back in good form of late when in the frame in 5f classified events at Wolverhampton and Lingfield (all-weather) last 2 runs. Not out of things back in handicap company.
Took a step forward in first-time tongue tie (retained) with third of 12 in handicap over C&D 19 days ago. Needs considering eased 1 lb in her bid for a maiden success.
Still looking for a first win. Off 15 months, shaped as if in need of the run when a fading fifth of 12 in handicap over C&D 19 days ago. Can build on it now.
It's now eighteen runs since his last win in 2024 and he came in last of 6 in 5f classified event at Wolverhampton in July. Lots more is needed after a break.
Scored at Newcastle (6f) last November. In good nick early in 2026 but his more recent form is less encouraging so others are preferred back from 3 months off.
Only success came at Beverley (5f) in May 2024 and he's failed to beat a rival on his last 3 runs.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Your Betting Guide Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: AFFETTUOSO looked a different model on the back of being gelded when a wide-margin winner at Lingfield and can follow up now stepping into handicap company for the first time. Nochebuena wasn't seen to anything like best effect at Doncaster last time and appeals as the chief threat to Roger Varian's improver ahead of Now Maybe.

runners.note: Study of Man filly got off the mark in novice at Doncaster in June and advanced that form when runner-up on handicap bow at Ascot (1½m) in July. Run best ignored (hampered and lost ground early) when ninth of 10 back at

Off 3 months (gelded) before easily landing the odds in 5-runner novice at Lingfield (1½m, all-weather) 24 days ago. This unexposed son of New Bay looks to have a fair bit more to offer on handicap debut. Interesting pro
A 3-time 1¼m winner at Newcastle late in 2025. Back from 4 months off in decent nick, seventh of 17 in handicap at Doncaster (1¼m, good to firm) last time. Not out of things with tongue tie added.
A 4-time winner (at up to 13f) in 2025. Runner-up at Ripon in June but has failed to beat a rival in all 3 subsequent runs. This course scorer has plenty to prove.

Placed 3 times in maidens for Jessica Harrington in Ireland. Changed hands for 68,000 gns and not discredited for new yard after 12-week break when fifth of 6 in handicap at Ascot (1¼m, good to firm) 31 days ago, needing

Debut winner at Wolverhampton (8.5f) in December. Yet to add to it this season but he's running well, third of 5 in handicap at Nottingham (1¼m, good) in July. No forlorn hope from an easing mark after a break.
Took a big step forward when opening his account over C&D in August on his final run for Pam Sly. Backed it up with a solid fourth of 10 back over C&D for new handler 2 weeks ago. Possibilities.

races.name: bettingsites.co.uk Each Way Extra Places Handicap
races.verdict: HE'S OUR CRACKER had a bit up his sleeve when resuming winning ways at Newcastle last week and is fancied to follow up under a penalty at the chief expense of Risen Again who could bounce back now sporting cheekpieces again. Fleur de Mer is a very long time without a victory but weighted to go well if shrugging off a lesser effort at Catterick.

runners.note: Got off the mark at Chelmsford (1¼m) in March. Doubled his tally after a break in refitted cheekpieces (retained) in 9-runner handicap at Newcastle (1¼m) 4 days ago. Scored cosily there so he holds very good claims under

Back in good form for his current yard when twice runner-up at Yarmouth and Chepstow in August. Blinkers replaced cheekpieces worn there when only ninth of 10 in handicap at Bath (1m, good to soft) last time. Could bounc

Best effort when runner-up at Lingfield (1¼m) in June but has failed to build on it since, fifth of 11 in handicap at Haydock (11.5f, good to soft) last time. More needed on his all-weather debut in a first-time visor.

Got off the mark at Kempton (1m) last April. Has steadily found his form again after a 13-month absence and posted a solid fourth of 12 in handicap at Wolverhampton (9.5f) 3 weeks ago. Not dismissed off a slipping mark.
Winless since 2023. Best run this season when second at Newcastle in August but only fifth of 6 in handicap at Catterick (1¾m, good) since. Handily weighted if back on her A-game.
Runner-up over C&D in February and one of his better efforts since when third of 9 back over C&D 19 days ago. Player if building on that with Gina Mangan back up replacing amateur.

Gained a first win over C&D in January. In good form on all-weather after but came in last of 12 at Beverley (1½m, good) in April and off the track since. Has won off a break though so no forlorn hope.
Limited-looking maiden who failed to get home in 1½m handicap at Wolverhampton in August. Hard to fancy here.
Remains a maiden after 31 runs and she came in last of 10 in handicap at Newcastle (1¼m) 4 days ago.
